PUBLIC SERVICES COMMITTEE
                                   MINUTES

Due to the Labor Day holiday, a meeting of the Public Services Committee was instead held on
Tuesday, September 2, 2025, in Council Chambers and via electronic meeting, starting at 12:00
p.m. Those in attendance were as follows:


COMMITTEE MEMBERS: Jeff White, Acting Chairman; Dr. Michelle Aldrich; Dr. Kathy
Emmons; and Dr. Mark Rinne. Absent: Tom Segrave, Chairman.


                                    AGENDA ITEMS

6.     ORDINANCE 3 READING
                      —                 —   Annexing to the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, land
       northeast of the intersection of Frontier Mali Drive and Rue Terre Avenue and west of
       Converse Avenue.

Dr. Emmons moved to approve on 3”' and final reading, seconded by Dr. Aldrich. Motion carried
by unanimous voice vote.

Connor White, Planning & Development Department Senior Planner, provided a staff report and
committee member Aldrich commented on the item.

7.     ORDINANCE        3”' READING      —Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of
       Cheyenne, establishing the zoning classification of CB Community Business for land
                                                                —




       annexed to the City of Cheyenne located northeast of the intersection of Frontier Mall
       Drive and Rue Terre Avenue and west of Converse Avenue.

Dr. Aldrich moved to approve on 3’ and final reading, seconded by Dr. Emmons. Motion carried
by unanimous voice vote.

Connor White, Planning & Development Department Senior Planner, provided a staff report.

8.     ORDINANCE 3t1 READING            —Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of
       Cheyenne, changing the zoning classification for land located southwest of the intersection
       of holland Court and Ridge Road from AG         — Agricultural to NR-2   —  Neighborhood
       Residential Medium Density.
                  —




Dr. Aldrich moved to approve on 3”' and final reading, seconded by Dr. Emmons. Motion carried
by unanimous voice vote.

Connor White, Planning & Development Department Senior Planner, provided a staff report.
